principles: Deterministic local authority before probabilistic enrichment
Signed evidence rather than reviewer prose
Fail closed for gate facts and fail local for host availability
drivers: Preserve critical and high specification recall
Reuse existing host and evidence infrastructure
Support safe staged rollout and rollback

options.name: A: Integrated versioned routing pipeline
pros: Implements all seven milestones on shared schemas
One canonical sanitizer and artifact model
cons: Requires careful phased commits and regression tests

options.name: C: Deterministic local search without host proposals
cons: Does not satisfy accepted multi-host design

rationale: Only option A satisfies B-f646 end to end: deterministic seeds remain authoritative, host proposals are sanitized advisory input, local search is bounded, evidence is signed, and rollout can be quality-gated.

preMortem.scenario: Relevant legacy specification falls below the candidate cutoff
preMortem.trigger: Low host overlap or tied scores near rank eight
preMortem.mitigation: Record ambiguity, escalate with scanEscalationReason, and require 100 percent critical/high golden recall before enforce.

preMortem.scenario: A Story secret leaks into a host proposal request
preMortem.trigger: Secret-like value appears in prose, backticks, sourceRef, path, title, config, or error text
preMortem.mitigation: Use one non-bypassable pre-egress sanitizer, names-not-values policy, local-only provenance map, and skip host on uncertain classification.

preMortem.scenario: Reviewer claims reads that did not occur
preMortem.trigger: Declared readManifest differs from mechanical read events
preMortem.consequence: False audit confidence and unsafe gate pass
preMortem.mitigation: Bind candidate and read digests and fail closed on missing stale forged or mismatched evidence.

preMortem.scenario: Rollout reduces review quality while improving token cost
preMortem.trigger: Finding-equivalence or golden recall regresses in shadow windows
preMortem.consequence: Missed defects despite lower prompt bytes
preMortem.mitigation: Block warn/enforce promotion until two consecutive windows meet recall equivalence cost and latency thresholds.

preMortem.trigger: Changes touch B-3928 lockfile or baseline inventory artifacts
preMortem.mitigation: Keep those paths excluded and use runtime-focused tests and schemas in B-8038 only.
